xmldoc.short_description: Add a color scale to axes.

param_input_item.param_description: Colorbar location: 'eastoutside', 'westoutside', 'northoutside', 'southoutside', 'east', 'west', 'north', 'south', or 'manual'. The tokens 'horizontal' and 'vertical' are accepted as compatibility aliases for 'southoutside' and 'eastoutside'.
Axes that owns the color scale. If omitted, the current axes is used.
Name-value pairs used to set colorbar properties when it is created.
Delete the colorbar associated with the current axes, the specified axes, or the specified colorbar.

description.p: colorbar adds a color scale to a plot. The colorbar is a graphics object parented to the figure and associated with a peer axes.

The default location is eastoutside. Outside locations reserve space next to the peer axes. Inside locations draw the colorbar over the axes area. Setting the Position property changes Location to manual.

The Location property also accepts layout for tiled layouts. Use colorbar(ax, 'Location', 'layout') and set c.Layout.Tile to a tile number or to 'east', 'west', 'north', or 'south'. The positional form colorbar(ax, 'layout') is not accepted.

Important visual properties include Box, Color, Direction, FontAngle, FontName, FontSize, FontWeight, Limits, LineWidth, AxisLocation, TickDirection, TickLabelInterpreter, TickLabels, TickLength, Ticks, Units, Visible, and Label.

Automatic Limits, Ticks, and TickLabels are updated from the peer axes color limits and colormap. Assigning Limits, Ticks, TickLabels, AxisLocation, or Position switches the corresponding mode property to manual when appropriate.
See colorbar properties for the complete property list.
